note: Adapted from Oshima's 1916 original description (in English), original name Eutermes (Eutermes) gracilis; no alate is described; the description includes the soldier and worker, type locality Laguna, Sarai (near Paete), Luzon, Philippines. The soldier total length is printed '8.00—3.50 mm' in the scan, the first figure being a scanning misread and treated here as 3.00—3.50 mm; the worker head length is printed 3.00 mm, which beside the soldier head length of 0.84 mm is evidently a misread for a value in the 0.30 mm range; the printed figures are recorded as they stand.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head circular with a slender conical nasus, the front surface of the nasus in the same plane as the vertex; antennae 12-segmented, segment 2 equal to segment 3, segment 4 far longer than segment 3; pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior margin shallowly bilobed. Worker head circular, the dorsal suture distinct and white, the base of the clypeus distinctly inflated, antennae 14-segmented.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head and antennae dull yellow, nasus reddish brown; abdomen and legs straw-coloured. Cephalic hairs very sparse; abdominal tergites with only microscopic fine hairs interspersed with a few setae. Head circular, nasus slender and conical, its front surface in the same plane as the vertex; mandibles pointed at the tip, vestigial. Antennae 12-segmented, segment 2 equal to segment 3, segment 4 far longer than segment 3; pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin bilobed. Measurements: total length 3.00—3.50 mm; head including nasus 1.59 mm; head length (without nasus) 0.84 mm; head width 0.93 mm; pronotum width 0.47 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head yellow; abdomen milky white; antennae and legs yellowish white. Pilosity of head and abdomen as in the soldier. Head circular, the dorsal suture distinct and white; base of the clypeus shorter than half its width and distinctly inflated; antennae 14-segmented, segment 2 the longest, about twice segment 4, segment 4 shorter than segment 3; pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin bilobed. Measurements: head length 3.00 mm; head width 1.03 mm; pronotum width 0.56 mm.
